# CLI reference

`dozebox` runs in operator mode on a machine with AWS credentials, and in box mode on the box (it detects
`/run/dozebox/`). The same command name can exist in both modes with a different meaning, such as `status`.
Flags that are not listed for a command are a usage error (exit code 2).

## Global options

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--box <id>` | Which box (default: the stack's box, else main). |
| `--stack <dir>` | Directory with stack.json and the Terraform root (default ./.dozebox). |
| `--json` | One JSON document on stdout; logs on stderr. |
| `--dry-run` | Print every call that would change state, change nothing. |
| `--yes` | Skip confirmation prompts (needed with --json for destructive commands). |
| `--verbose` | Debug logs on stderr. |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | Done. |
| 1 | The command ran and found a problem, for example `doctor` found a failing check. |
| 2 | Usage error: an unknown flag, a missing argument or a bad value. |
| 3 | Not set up: there is no stack, or the stack lacks a Terraform output. Run `dozebox setup`. |
| 4 | AWS or the network failed after retries. |
| 5 | The control function refused: the box is frozen, over budget, or the request conflicts with its state. |
| 75 | Try again later: the wake budget is used up or a lock is held. |
| 130 | Interrupted with Ctrl-C. |

## Operator commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `dozebox bootstrap` | Create the state bucket and deploy principal policies; activate the cost tag. |
| `dozebox setup` | Re-runnable setup: apply, store the wake token, subscribe alerts, run doctor. |
| `dozebox deploy` | Run terraform init and apply in the stack directory. |
| `dozebox status` | Print the control function status; --records and --releases add detail. |
| `dozebox wake` | Wake the box and optionally wait until it serves. |
| `dozebox park` | Ask the control function to park the box. |
| `dozebox upgrade` | Set the agent version and apply. |
| `dozebox doctor` | Check tools, credentials, the stack and the alert path. |
| `dozebox secrets set` | Store a shared secret; the value is read from stdin, never from a flag. |
| `dozebox secrets list` | List the shared secret names (never values). |
| `dozebox secrets delete` | Delete a shared secret. |
| `dozebox token show` | Print the wake link &lt;control_url&gt;/#t=&lt;token&gt;. |
| `dozebox token rotate` | Store a new wake token; every old wake link stops working. |
| `dozebox phone pair` | Pair a phone: prints a link with the wake token and a new approve token. |
| `dozebox phone list` | List paired phones. |
| `dozebox phone revoke` | Revoke a paired phone's approve token. |
| `dozebox alerts test` | Send a test alert through every sink. |
| `dozebox alerts path` | Show the alert path verdict. |
| `dozebox snapshots list` | List the box's data volume snapshots, newest first. |
| `dozebox snapshots create` | Snapshot the active data volume; waits until completed unless --no-wait. |
| `dozebox snapshots delete` | Delete one snapshot of the box. |
| `dozebox restore` | Restore the data volume from a snapshot. |
| `dozebox volumes list` | List the box volumes; flags a box with no active volume. |
| `dozebox volumes retire` | Tag a volume retired (never the active one); it is kept until you delete it. |
| `dozebox move-az` | Move the data volume to another availability zone. |
| `dozebox rebuild` | Replace the instance and keep the volume. |
| `dozebox unfreeze` | Run the unfreeze runbook after a kill-switch freeze. |
| `dozebox destroy` | Snapshot every tagged volume, then terraform destroy. |
| `dozebox drill` | Run a real-AWS drill: smoke, spot, fallback, kill, front-door, restore. |

### `dozebox bootstrap`

Create the state bucket and deploy principal policies; activate the cost tag.

Changes state. Honours `--dry-run` and asks before it acts (`--yes` skips the question).

| `--region` | value |  |
| `--state-bucket` | value |  |
| `--test-account` | value |  |
| `--source` | value |  |

## Box commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `dozebox status` | Show this box's phase, what keeps it awake, holds and wakes. |
| `dozebox hold` | Keep the box awake until a time, or release the hold. |
| `dozebox beat` | Tell the box this payload is making progress, once or on a loop. |
| `dozebox wake` | Ask the box to wake at a time or on a GitHub event, or cancel that request. |
| `dozebox presence` | Say a person is here (up to 15 minutes), so the box stays awake. |
| `dozebox attention` | Send the operator an alert, deduplicated by key. |
| `dozebox run` | Run a command while holding the box awake; beat on output, alert on failure. |
| `dozebox sleep` | Ask the box to park now. |

### `dozebox status`
